# Fixtures from elsewhere

`ocsf-authentication.json` is the authentication class of the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework
(https://github.com/ocsf/ocsf-schema), version 1.10.0-dev, compiled by `ocsf-schema-compiler` and cut to the
attributes' type, object type, array flag, requirement, caption and description. OCSF is licensed under the Apache
License 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

`ecs-flat-excerpt.yml` is ten fields of `generated/ecs/ecs_flat.yml` from the Elastic Common Schema
(https://github.com/elastic/ecs), each block whole. ECS is licensed under the Apache License 2.0:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
